role: A hash map keyed by longs, used for chunk-keyed lookups (ChunkProviderServer, PlayerManager, BiomeCache, Teleporter) and by MapGenStructure's structureMap.

members.name: table/capacity/count/versionIterator
members.note: only the structureMap use was ported (populate.c keeps the per-generator maps as jhm64 keyed by chunk key); the chunk-cache users keep flat arrays instead

members.name: getValueByKey
members.note: populate.c reads by probing jhm64_contains and indexing its own piece list; no value-returning get

members.name: resizeTable
members.note: JDK-8 chain-split order emulated in jhashmap.c, fixed capacity

members.name: remove
members.note: no removal in the structureMap use; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: Entry.getKey/getHash/getValue/equals/hashCode/toString
members.note: the entry's own accessors: LongHashMap reads the fields directly; getKey is called only by Entry.equals and Entry.toString, which have no caller in oracle/src (entries are never compared or printed)

notes: jhashmap.c's jhm64 half exists to reproduce the JDK 8 HashMap iteration order that MapGenStructure's structureMap (a LongHashMap) iterates in; only that use was traced. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers. Formerly listed as missing: LongHashMap.remove has no native counterpart; nothing removes from the ported structure maps. The chunk-cache users (ChunkProviderClient, PlayerManager, BiomeCache, Teleporter) replace the map with their own arrays rather than a shared port.
